about_the_game:
Sleepover: reWake is a Gay Adult/BL Visual Novel featuring the short story of Kano, a simple guy living in a small town deep in the province. His best friend, Aki, was inseparable from him throughout the two’s childhood, but soon after left to attend college in the far-off city, and drifted apart from Kano.

One day out of nowhere, Aki texts Kano requesting to meetup, and through a twist of fate, the two are offered the opportunity to spend not only the full day, but also the night together – their last sleepover.

Help Kano navigate the two’s changed relationship, and create the special bond with Aki that he always wished they had. One night is all it takes!

A Heartfelt Remake!

Sleepover: reWake is a retelling of the classic Gay/Adult Yaoi Visual Novel first produced in 2014. Now acquired as a BLits title, the game was re-written and remastered to be a heartfelt, charming retelling of the original story, with new twists and turns!

Meaningful Choices & Endings!

Kano and Aki’s story is filled with choices – your decisions impact how the two’s relationship will unfold! Make sure and choose the right paths to secure a happy ending for these two former best friends!

Sleepover: reWake features three unique endings, each with varying content, so make sure to seek out the best one!

Fully Remastered & Brand-New Artwork!

Enjoy fully updated & remastered artwork from the original Sleepover Title, including 30+ scene images and sex scenes – some of which are brand new, never seen before!

All game interfaces have also been remade and customized to blend seamlessly with the game experience!

Full Sex Scene Control & Immersion!

When things get spicy, choose the path Kano and Aki will pursue while exploring each other’s bodies – it’s entirely up to you what sexual roles they take, what position they end up in next, and even when they finish! Play multiple times to experience all 16 sex scenes!

Additionally, the game also includes a new layer of sex scene immersion – erotic voices from the characters and improved screenplay for your viewing pleasure!

Full Voice Acting

Newly included in Sleepover: reWake, the game is fully voiced – all scenes contain full voice acting, immersing the player with the character’s experiences and stories!

Gallery & Sprite Viewer

View all unlocked images in the game’s gallery from the main menu once they’ve been experienced in-game – make sure and unlock them all!

Additionally, view Kano and Aki’s various sprite costumes, expressions and character information inside of the Sprite Viewer!

Music Player

Finally, replay the catchy theme music of the game, as well as all in-game soundtracks right from the start inside of the music player!

Lovense Connectivity

Connect your Lovense device to your game to experience all the same sensations that Kano and Aki do in the erotic scenes of the game!

content_descriptors.notes:
Sleepover: ReWake is a gay/yaoi visual novel strictly intended for adult audiences only. The game includes graphic sexual relations and explicit imagery between two consenting adult male characters.

Other sexual content includes gratuitous male nudity, bodily fluids, suggestive dialogue and situations, and other sexual themes such as crude language, pornography and more.

Viewers who are not comfortable with any of these categories should avoid playing the game.
